# @zakkster/lite-headless/select

Headless single-select listbox-button (the WAI-ARIA APG "select-only combobox"
/ listbox-button pattern). A button trigger opens a listbox popup; the user
picks one option. NO text editing -- that is what `combobox` is for. Focus stays
on the trigger; the highlighted option rides `aria-activedescendant`.

WAI-ARIA APG: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/combobox/examples/combobox-select-only/

Reuses the shared overlay seams (core state machine, roving-focus highlight +
typeahead, positioner, dismiss, portal, aria) MINUS the editable-input lane
(ADR 0008). Consumers own the option DOM; the primitive coordinates state, ARIA,
keyboard, highlight, and placement (attach-model, ADR 0006).

## Quick example

```js
import { createSelect } from "@zakkster/lite-headless/select";

const select = createSelect({
    defaultValue: "apple",
    onValueChange: (v, reason) => console.log("picked", v, "via", reason),
});

select.attachTrigger(triggerButtonEl);   // role=button, aria-haspopup=listbox
select.attachListbox(ulEl);               // role=listbox
select.attachItem(li1, { value: "apple",  label: "Apple" });
select.attachItem(li2, { value: "banana", label: "Banana" });
select.attachItem(li3, { value: "cherry", label: "Cherry", disabled: true });
```

## Options

| Option                | Default          | Notes                                                        |
| --------------------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `open`                | -                | Signal<boolean> for controlled open state                   |
| `defaultOpen`         | `false`          | Uncontrolled initial open state                             |
| `onOpenChange`        | -                | `(open, reason) => void`                                     |
| `value`               | -                | Signal for controlled selected value                        |
| `defaultValue`        | `null`           | Uncontrolled initial value                                  |
| `onValueChange`       | -                | `(value, reason) => void`                                    |
| `placement`           | `"bottom-start"` | Listbox placement                                           |
| `offset`              | `4`              | Gap between trigger and listbox (px)                        |
| `flip` / `shift`      | `true`           | Positioning behaviour                                        |
| `boundary`            | `"clipping"`     | Positioning boundary                                        |
| `typeahead`           | `true`           | Type-to-select first-letter match                          |
| `typeaheadTimeout`    | `500`            | Buffer reset (ms)                                           |
| `loop`                | `true`           | Arrow-key wrap at the ends                                 |
| `autoFocus`           | `"selected"`     | Initial highlight: `"selected"` \| `"first"` \| `"none"`    |
| `closeOnSelect`       | `true`           | Close listbox after a selection                            |
| `closeOnEscape`       | `true`           | Escape dismisses                                            |
| `closeOnOutsideClick` | `true`           | Outside pointerdown dismisses                               |
| `container`           | `document.body`  | Portal target for the listbox                              |
| `transition`          | `false`          | Await transitionend before the status flip                 |
| `positioner`          | -                | Pluggable positioning engine (combobox/menu parity)        |

`reason` values: `"trigger"`, `"select"`, `"escape"`, `"tab"`, `"outside"`,
`"api"`.

## API

```
select.open()                    -- ReadSignal<boolean>
select.status()                  -- "closed" | "opening" | "open" | "closing"
select.setOpen(open, reason?)
select.toggle(reason?)
select.value()                   -- current selected value (or null)
select.setValue(value, reason?)
select.attachTrigger(el)         -- role=button, aria-haspopup=listbox, listeners
select.attachListbox(el)         -- role=listbox
select.attachItem(el, { value, label?, disabled? })  -- role=option
select.attachInside(el)          -- extend the outside-click ignore list
select.destroy()
select.destroyed                 -- boolean
```

## Keyboard (APG parity)

| Key                        | State  | Action                              |
| -------------------------- | ------ | ----------------------------------- |
| ArrowDown / ArrowUp / Enter / Space | closed | Open the listbox                    |
| printable char             | closed | Open + typeahead                    |
| ArrowDown / ArrowUp        | open   | Move highlight (wraps if `loop`)    |
| Home / End                 | open   | First / last enabled option         |
| Enter / Space              | open   | Select highlighted, close           |
| Escape                     | open   | Close without selecting             |
| Tab                        | open   | Close, continue normal tab flow     |
| printable char             | open   | Typeahead (buffered, timeout-reset) |

Disabled options are skipped by navigation and typeahead and cannot be selected.

## Painted-attribute (CSS) contract

Trigger (`[data-trigger]`):
```
role="button"
aria-haspopup="listbox"
aria-expanded="true|false"
aria-controls="<listbox id>"
aria-activedescendant="<highlighted option id>"   (while open)
```

Listbox (`[data-listbox]`):
```
role="listbox"
aria-hidden="true"        (when closed)
data-open                 (present when open)
data-status="closed|opening|open|closing"
data-side / data-align    (from the positioner)
```

Option (`[data-item]`):
```
role="option"
aria-selected="true|false"
data-selected             (present when selected)
data-highlighted          (present when highlighted)
aria-disabled="true"      (when disabled)
data-disabled             (when disabled)
```

## Custom element wrapper

```html
<lite-select value="apple">
    <button data-trigger>Apple</button>
    <ul data-listbox>
        <li data-item data-value="apple">Apple</li>
        <li data-item data-value="banana">Banana</li>
        <li data-item data-value="cherry" data-disabled>Cherry</li>
    </ul>
</lite-select>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute      | Effect                                                  |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `value`        | Reactive selected value (reflected)                    |
| `open`         | Reactive open state (reflected)                        |
| `placement`    | Listbox placement                                      |
| `offset`       | Gap (px)                                               |
| `no-flip` / `no-shift` / `no-loop` / `no-typeahead` | Disable the behaviour        |
| `auto-focus`   | `"selected"` \| `"first"` \| `"none"`                  |
| `no-close-on-select` / `no-escape` / `no-outside`   | Disable dismissal            |
| `transition`   | Await transitionend before the status flip             |
| `container`    | Portal target selector (`self`/`none` to keep in place)|

### Imperative API on host

```js
host.setOpen(bool, reason?)
host.setValue(value, reason?)
host.toggle()
```

## What this is NOT

- editable: no text field, no query. Use `combobox` for the editable pattern.
- multi-select: single-select is the shipped scope; multi is deferred (LH-12).
- a data-model select: it renders nothing; you own the option DOM (ADR 0006).
- virtualization: pair with `@zakkster/lite-virtual` when needed.
